subject: mathematics
concept: Reading, writing, and understanding place value for decimals to two places (hundredths)
source_inspiration: adapted from Singapore CPA sequencing principles — original content, not copied text

exercise.concrete: Student builds a decimal value using hundredths-grid virtual blocks
exercise.pictorial: Student reads a shaded hundredths grid and writes the matching decimal
exercise.abstract: Student writes decimals to two places from a spoken/written value

misconception_flags: confuses hundredths place with tenths place

interest_binding: exercise regenerated using student's stated interest profile
